AUTHORITY, NOT JUST SUMMARY

Authority bench

Export your collection

Export briefs and cards, or a full backup including exams, tasks, outlines, review history, source documents and written attempts, applied exercises, statutory maps and rubric revision workspaces. Files are generated locally.

Flashcard CSV columns: Front, Back, Course, Topic, Court. Keep a JSON backup to restore your collection.

Your query is sent to OpenRouter, its model provider and search provider. Search and extraction use your OpenRouter credits. Keys are cleared when this dialog closes and never saved.

Selected source text · review before extraction

Search returns excerpts, not a guaranteed full judgment. Confirm that you have the intended opinion and enough text for a brief. You can paste a fuller judgment here; AI uses only this text and leaves unsupported fields blank.

Supported opinion sources: Justia, CourtListener, Cornell LII and selected U.S. court sites. Source trust is not a check that the case remains good law.

Upload a case

Extract a draft from a judgment or excerpt, then review it before saving.

Your key is held only in memory while this dialog is open. It is never included in saved cases or exports.

PDF, DOCX or UTF-8 TXT · up to 20 MB and 160,000 extracted characters. Text-based PDFs only; no OCR. Extracted text is sent to OpenRouter and its model provider when you click Extract draft. API usage uses your account credits.
